correctness.rationale: Directly checked Fourier normalization: r∂_r and r²∂²_r/2 applied to product eigenvalue (1+r)^(d-k)(1-r)^k give u_k,v_k. Convex parabola normals p_k are exposed, and strict positive Walsh spectral weights give barycenter zero and no redundant facet. The support lemma for multilinear Walsh degree ≤t is proved by splitting last coordinate and induction. Applying it to each active homogeneous level and its parity twist yields sharp supports; explicit pair-products attain equality. For two consecutive levels the same dual degree bounds and one extra factor (1+x_j) attain support; degree {0,d} gives parity-class size. PSD extension by zero equates first singular principal subset with least support of a global null vector. Independent rational checks d=2..6 verify polygon and active-shell algebra. This is a proof for all d,r; finite checks are corroboration only.
